description: Software delivery measures: change lead time, deployment frequency and failed deployment recovery time (throughput); change fail rate and deployment rework rate (instability).
A framework for developer productivity with five dimensions: satisfaction and well-being, performance, activity, communication and collaboration, efficiency and flow.
The difference between how much faster developers feel with AI and what is measured. METR's randomized study found a predicted 24% speedup and a measured 19% slowdown.
DORA's finding that AI magnifies existing organizational strengths and dysfunctions.
A number that rises without better outcomes, such as lines generated or suggestions accepted.
A metric that must not get worse while you optimize another, such as change fail rate during an agent rollout.
